title: Singular demonstratives review
focus: Mix singular form, reference, independent use, noun modification, and standard person reference.

exercises.prompt: Choose the sentence that means “That is a car.” Beside a noticeboard. Use auto (“a car”) and on (“is”). The referent is already identifiable from the conversation.
exercises.explanation: Se is the singular demonstrative for a situation where the listener can identify the referent.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: demonstrative subject: identifies the referent + linking verb + identity information

Correct. Se is the singular demonstrative for a situation where the listener can identify the referent.
“Tämä” is a singular nominative form for a referent near the speaker; use “Se”, a singular nominative form for an already identifiable non-human referent.
“Tuo” is a singular nominative form for a farther, jointly visible referent; use “Se”, a singular nominative form for an already identifiable non-human referent.
